Homemade ice cream does not contain the
stabilizers used in commercial ice cream to
increase body and stave off melting.  Nor
does it contain artificial flavorings, as many
commercial products do.  The result is a
texture and taste that are very different from
those of commercial ice cream. 
Most commercial ice cream has around
10 percent milk fat and added sweeteners
and so a high calorie count.  The count
increases with the number of high-calorie
mix-ins:  pieces of fruits, nuts, candy, and
cookies with flavored syrups in ribbons,
swirls, and ripples.  Many of these ingre-
dients have added fat.
